pill.desc: colorless to light yellow solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

clues.kinetics: Its metabolic pathway has not been characterized. It is expected to be degraded into small peptides and amino acids through ordinary catabolic pathways.
clues.substance: A sterile, preservative-free solution of 1326 amino acids, supplied in single-dose prefilled syringes or vials.
clues.product: Approved under a BLA as 45 mg/0.5 mL and 90 mg/mL prefilled syringes, plus 130 mg/26 mL intravenous vials; maintenance is every 8 to 12 weeks.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated with clinically significant hypersensitivity to it or its excipients; arthralgia and nausea were more frequent than with placebo.
clues.indication: Moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, active psoriatic arthritis, and moderately to severely active Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
clues.mechanism: It binds the p40 subunit shared by the cytokines interleukin-12 and interleukin-23, disrupting their signalling through a shared receptor chain.

tell: Its p40 target is shared by two cytokines, IL-12 and IL-23, setting this antibody apart.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: 13.5 days and 7 days, respectively, after a single subcutaneous administration of 45 mg (N=22) and 90 mg (N=24)
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: an estimated median terminal half-life of approximately 19 days
